caption: The video captures a tranquil sea at a low sun, the bright disc resting on a flat horizon beneath an overcast sky. Its light throws a broken, glittering column across the water, and that reflection shimmers continuously as small ripples rearrange the surface from frame to frame. On the right, a steep dark cliff is crowned by a pale building, both holding fixed positions while the camera holds a steady framing. Along the right shoreline a thin line of white foam crests and laps the pebbly beach in ongoing surf, its shape shifting rather than forming a single wave. A small dark object sits at the water's edge below the cliff. A tiny dark speck left of the sun, just above the horizon, drifts slowly leftward and upward across the clip. The foreground shore, horizon, and cliff remain unchanged as the sea's gentle motion carries on.
